4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

5. **Use it.** `import { Menubar, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarContent, MenubarGroup, … } from '@/ui/components/menubar';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. ## Specification

### Component: Menubar

A desktop-style bar of menus (File / Edit / View), following the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern. Panels, items and submenus are the DropdownMenu's own parts.

#### Anatomy
```
<Menubar>                       <div class="ui-menubar" role="menubar" aria-orientation="horizontal">
  <MenubarMenu value="file">    context: is this menu open; shares open method with the bar
    <MenubarTrigger />          <button class="ui-menubar-trigger" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded>
    <MenubarContent>            <div class="ui-floating ui-menu ui-menubar-content" role="menu" aria-labelledby=trigger>
      <MenubarItem /> <MenubarCheckboxItem /> <MenubarRadioGroup><MenubarRadioItem />
      <MenubarLabel /> <MenubarSeparator /> <MenubarGroup />
      <MenubarSub> <MenubarSubTrigger /> <MenubarSubContent />
```

#### Props
- `Menubar`: `value` (open menu value or `null`), `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`; native div props.
- `MenubarMenu`: `value` (id of the menu; generated when omitted).
- `MenubarContent`: `placement` (default `bottom-start`), `offset` (default 6).
- Items: same as the DropdownMenu counterparts.

#### Behaviour
- One tab stop for the bar (roving tabindex): the first trigger is `tabindex=0` until another one is focused or clicked.
- On a title (closed): `→`/`←` move focus to the next/previous title (wrap); `Home`/`End` first/last; `↓`, `Enter`, `Space` open with the first item focused; `↑` opens on the last item.
- Click toggles a menu. Only one menu is open at a time.
- With a menu open: `→`/`←` on an item (not a submenu trigger, not inside a submenu) switch to the next/previous menu, opening it with its first item focused; a submenu trigger consumes `→`, a submenu `←`.
- With a menu open, moving the mouse onto another title switches to that menu (pointer only, never touch); with none open, hover does nothing.
- Esc closes and returns focus to the title; a click outside closes without moving focus; Tab closes; choosing an item closes the bar.

#### Visual rules
- Bar: inline-flex, height 40px, padding 4px, gap 2px, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface-raised`, `--ui-shadow-xs`; scrolls horizontally on narrow screens with no scrollbar.
- Title: height 30px, padding 0 10px, `--radius-md`, 14px / 500; hover and open: `--ui-accent` background and `--ui-accent-foreground`; keyboard focus ring `0 0 0 3px` `--ui-ring` at 45%.
- Panel min-width 12rem, then the dropdown menu's rules.

#### Motion
- Title tint 150ms standard ease. Panel `ui-pop-in` 150ms from the title side; close `ui-pop-out` 160ms. Switching menus closes and opens in the same frame.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA menubar: titles are `role="menuitem"` with `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` (only while open); each menu is labelled by its title.

#### Acceptance checks
- Exactly one title has `tabindex=0`.
- Menu opens 6px below its title, left-aligned.
- `→` in an open menu switches menus and focuses the first item of the new one; focus never lands on `<body>`.
- Hover switch works only after a menu is open.
- Submenu `→`/`←` do not switch menus.
- No serious axe violations while open.

### `ui/components/menubar/menubar.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type FocusEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type MutableRefObject,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';
import {
  MenuPanelContext,
  MenuRootContext,
  focusItem,
  isOwnEvent,
  ownedItems,
  useMenuRoot,
  type ActiveSub,
  type OpenMethod,
} from '../dropdown-menu/menu-context';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

type Move = 'next' | 'prev' | 'first' | 'last';

interface MenubarContextValue {
  /** Value of the open menu, or null. */
  value: string | null;
  setMenuOpen: (menu: string, open: boolean) => void;
  tabStop: string | null;
  setTabStop: (menu: string) => void;
  /** Shared by every menu: only one is ever open. */
  openMethod: MutableRefObject<OpenMethod>;
  skipFocusReturn: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  /** Move to another top-level trigger; when a menu is open it switches to that menu. */
  move: (from: HTMLElement | null, to: Move) => void;
  /** Open another menu because the pointer entered its trigger. */
  hoverSwitch: (menu: string) => void;
}

const MenubarContext = createContext<MenubarContextValue | null>(null);

function useMenubarContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(MenubarContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Menubar>.`);
  return ctx;
}

const MenubarMenuContext = createContext<string | null>(null);

const TRIGGERS = '[data-menubar-trigger]:not([disabled])';

export interface MenubarProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue'> {
  /** Controlled: the value of the open menu (null for none). */
  value?: string | null;
  /** Initial open menu when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string | null;
  /** Called when the open menu changes. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string | null) => void;
}

/**
 * Menubar — a desktop-style bar of menus (WAI-ARIA menubar). Left / Right
 * move between menus (and switch the open one), Down opens, and once a menu
 * is open, hovering another title switches to it.
 */
export const Menubar = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MenubarProps>(function Menubar(
  { value: valueProp, defaultValue = null, onValueChange, className, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string | null>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, rootRef);
  const openMethod = useRef<OpenMethod>('pointer');
  const skipFocusReturn = useRef(false);
  const [tabStop, setTabStop] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // One tab stop for the whole bar: the first trigger until another one is focused
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tabStop !== null) return;
    const first = rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(TRIGGERS);
    if (first?.dataset.menuValue) setTabStop(first.dataset.menuValue);
  }, [tabStop]);

  const setMenuOpen = useCallback(
    (menu: string, open: boolean) => setValue((cur) => (open ? menu : cur === menu ? null : cur)),
    [setValue],
  );

  const move = useCallback(
    (from: HTMLElement | null, to: Move) => {
      const list = Array.from(rootRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(TRIGGERS) ?? []);
      if (!list.length) return;
      const i = from ? list.indexOf(from) : -1;
      const next =
        to === 'first'
          ? list[0]
          : to === 'last'
            ? list[list.length - 1]
            : list[(i + (to === 'next' ? 1 : -1) + list.length) % list.length];
      if (!next?.dataset.menuValue) return;
      setTabStop(next.dataset.menuValue);
      if (value !== null) {
        openMethod.current = 'keyboard';
        skipFocusReturn.current = true;
        setValue(next.dataset.menuValue);
      } else {
        next.focus();
      }
    },
    [value, setValue],
  );

  const hoverSwitch = useCallback(
    (menu: string) => {
      if (value === null || value === menu) return;
      openMethod.current = 'pointer';
      skipFocusReturn.current = true;
      setTabStop(menu);
      setValue(menu);
    },
    [value, setValue],
  );

  const ctx = useMemo(
    () => ({ value, setMenuOpen, tabStop, setTabStop, openMethod, skipFocusReturn, move, hoverSwitch }),
    [value, setMenuOpen, tabStop, move, hoverSwitch],
  );

  return (
    <MenubarContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="menubar"
        aria-orientation="horizontal"
        data-state={value !== null ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        className={cn('ui-menubar', className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </MenubarContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface MenubarMenuProps {
  /** Identifies the menu in the bar's `value`. Generated when omitted. */
  value?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/** One menu of the bar: a trigger and its content. */
export function MenubarMenu({ value, children }: MenubarMenuProps) {
  const bar = useMenubarContext('MenubarMenu');
  const id = useId();
  const menu = value ?? id;
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const { setMenuOpen, openMethod, skipFocusReturn } = bar;
  const open = bar.value === menu;
  const setOpen = useCallback((next: boolean) => setMenuOpen(menu, next), [setMenuOpen, menu]);
  const closeMenu = useCallback(() => setMenuOpen(menu, false), [setMenuOpen, menu]);

  const root = useMemo(
    () => ({
      open,
      setOpen,
      triggerRef,
      triggerId: `${id}-trigger`,
      contentId: `${id}-content`,
      openMethod,
      skipFocusReturn,
      closeMenu,
    }),
    [open, setOpen, id, openMethod, skipFocusReturn, closeMenu],
  );

  return (
    <MenubarMenuContext.Provider value={menu}>
      <MenuRootContext.Provider value={root}>{children}</MenuRootContext.Provider>
    </MenubarMenuContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface MenubarTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {}

/** The menu title in the bar. */
export const MenubarTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, MenubarTriggerProps>(function MenubarTrigger(
  { className, onClick, onKeyDown, onFocus, onPointerEnter, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const bar = useMenubarContext('MenubarTrigger');
  const root = useMenuRoot('MenubarTrigger');
  const menu = useContext(MenubarMenuContext) as string;
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, root.triggerRef as RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>);

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      id={root.triggerId}
      type="button"
      role="menuitem"
      tabIndex={bar.tabStop === menu ? 0 : -1}
      aria-haspopup="menu"
      aria-expanded={root.open}
      aria-controls={root.open ? root.contentId : undefined}
      data-menubar-trigger=""
      data-menu-value={menu}
      data-state={root.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      className={cn('ui-menubar-trigger', className)}
      onFocus={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onFocus?.(e);
        bar.setTabStop(menu);
      }}
      onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') bar.hoverSwitch(menu);
      }}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
        bar.setTabStop(menu);
        // detail 0 = activated from the keyboard (Enter / Space)
        root.openMethod.current = e.detail === 0 ? 'keyboard' : 'pointer';
        root.setOpen(!root.open);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        switch (e.key) {
          case 'ArrowRight':
            e.preventDefault();
            bar.move(el, 'next');
            return;
          case 'ArrowLeft':
            e.preventDefault();
            bar.move(el, 'prev');
            return;
          case 'Home':
            e.preventDefault();
            bar.move(el, 'first');
            return;
          case 'End':
            e.preventDefault();
            bar.move(el, 'last');
            return;
          case 'ArrowDown':
          case 'ArrowUp':
            e.preventDefault();
            root.openMethod.current = e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? 'keyboard-last' : 'keyboard';
            root.setOpen(true);
            return;
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type MenubarContentProps = Omit<
  FloatingContentProps,
  'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'arrow' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'
>;

/** The menu panel under its title. */
export const MenubarContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MenubarContentProps>(function MenubarContent(
  { placement = 'bottom-start', offset = 6, className, children, onKeyDown, onPointerLeave, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const bar = useMenubarContext('MenubarContent');
  const root = useMenuRoot('MenubarContent');
  const ownerId = useId();
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);
  const activeSub = useRef<ActiveSub | null>(null);
  const panel = useMemo(() => ({ ownerId, activeSub }), [ownerId]);
  const rove = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: ownedItems(ownerId) });

  useDismiss(root.open, [panelRef, root.triggerRef], (reason) => {
    root.skipFocusReturn.current = reason === 'outside';
    root.setOpen(false);
  });

  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={root.open}
      anchorRef={root.triggerRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      role="menu"
      id={root.contentId}
      tabIndex={-1}
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-labelledby={root.triggerId}
      className={cn('ui-menu ui-menubar-content', className)}
      returnFocusRef={root.triggerRef}
      skipFocusReturnRef={root.skipFocusReturn}
      onOpened={(el) => {
        const method = root.openMethod.current;
        if (method === 'pointer') el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        else focusItem(el, ownerId, method === 'keyboard-last' ? 'last' : 'first');
        root.openMethod.current = 'pointer';
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || !isOwnEvent(e)) return;
        if (e.key === 'Tab') {
          e.preventDefault();
          root.closeMenu();
          return;
        }
        // A submenu trigger consumes ArrowRight and a submenu ArrowLeft, so these are for the bar
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
          e.preventDefault();
          bar.move(root.triggerRef.current, e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 'next' : 'prev');
          return;
        }
        rove(e);
      }}
      onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerLeave?.(e);
        const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' && !activeSub.current && active?.dataset.menuOwner === ownerId) {
          e.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <MenuPanelContext.Provider value={panel}>{children}</MenuPanelContext.Provider>
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/menubar.css`

```css
/* Menubar -----------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-menubar" role="menubar">
     <button class="ui-menubar-trigger" role="menuitem" data-state="open|closed">File</button>
   Panels are .ui-floating.ui-menu.ui-menubar-content and reuse the dropdown
   menu's .ui-menu-* item classes.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-menubar {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    height: 2.5rem;
    padding: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .ui-menubar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .ui-menubar-trigger {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    height: 1.875rem;
    padding: 0 0.625rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: default;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-menubar-trigger[data-state="open"] {
    background: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  }
  .ui-menubar-trigger:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-menubar-trigger:hover { background: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }
  @media (hover: none) {
    .ui-menubar-trigger { cursor: pointer; }
  }

  .ui-menubar-content { min-width: 12rem; }
}
```

## Usage

**App menubar** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/menubar/app-menubar.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Menubar, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarLabel, MenubarMenu, MenubarRadioGroup, MenubarRadioItem, MenubarSeparator, MenubarSub, MenubarSubContent, MenubarSubTrigger, MenubarTrigger } from '@/ui/components/menubar';

export default function MenubarApp() {
  const [sidebar, setSidebar] = useState(true);
  const [statusBar, setStatusBar] = useState(false);
  const [density, setDensity] = useState('default');
  const [last, setLast] = useState('Nothing chosen yet');
  const run = (text: string) => () => setLast(text);

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md justify-items-start gap-3">
      <Menubar aria-label="Application">
        <MenubarMenu value="file">
          <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent className="w-56">
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘N" onSelect={run('New file')}>
              New file
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⇧⌘N" onSelect={run('New window')}>
              New window
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSub>
              <MenubarSubTrigger>Open recent</MenubarSubTrigger>
              <MenubarSubContent className="w-52">
                <MenubarItem onSelect={run('Opened roadmap.md')}>roadmap.md</MenubarItem>
                <MenubarItem onSelect={run('Opened pricing.tsx')}>pricing.tsx</MenubarItem>
                <MenubarItem onSelect={run('Opened onboarding.fig')}>onboarding.fig</MenubarItem>
              </MenubarSubContent>
            </MenubarSub>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘S" onSelect={run('Saved')}>
              Save
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem disabled>Export as PDF…</MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘P" onSelect={run('Printing')}>
              Print…
            </MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>

        <MenubarMenu value="edit">
          <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent className="w-52">
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘Z" onSelect={run('Undo')}>
              Undo
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⇧⌘Z" onSelect={run('Redo')}>
              Redo
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘X" onSelect={run('Cut')}>
              Cut
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘C" onSelect={run('Copy')}>
              Copy
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem shortcut="⌘V" onSelect={run('Paste')}>
              Paste
            </MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>

        <MenubarMenu value="view">
          <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent className="w-56">
            <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={sidebar} onCheckedChange={setSidebar}>
              Show sidebar
            </MenubarCheckboxItem>
            <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={statusBar} onCheckedChange={setStatusBar}>
              Show status bar
            </MenubarCheckboxItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarLabel>Density</MenubarLabel>
            <MenubarRadioGroup value={density} onValueChange={setDensity}>
              <MenubarRadioItem value="compact">Compact</MenubarRadioItem>
              <MenubarRadioItem value="default">Default</MenubarRadioItem>
              <MenubarRadioItem value="comfortable">Comfortable</MenubarRadioItem>
            </MenubarRadioGroup>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>
      </Menubar>
      <p role="status" className="px-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {last} · sidebar {sidebar ? 'on' : 'off'} · {density}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
